name: Band Lateral Walk
steps: Loop a resistance band around your ankles or just above your knees and stand in a shallow athletic quarter squat with feet hip-width apart.
Keep your chest tall, core braced, and toes pointing straight forward.
Step smoothly out to one side with your lead foot, then bring your trailing foot partway in without losing tension on the band.
Continue taking alternating side steps for the set, then travel back in the opposite direction to work both sides evenly.
tips: Keep enough space between your feet so the band never goes slack.
Avoid swaying your upper torso from side to side as you step.
